additional_info.subject: RE: ID0381439-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N0 160382434] Display blackscreen CRM:00643000939
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
Please perform the following steps to address the issue with the black screen:
1. Check for any loose connections between the screen and board.
2. Update the Dlogic firmware if it has not been updated previously.
3. Verify the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board from the XD21 & XD22 terminals.
4. Check if the DP cables have been replaced with this charger in the past. If not, consider replacing them with new DP cables.
5. Inspect the FC12 to FC17 fuses to see if they are in a solid red state. If so, replace the fuse.
6. If the issue persists, consider using a spare HMI for replacement if necessary.

Hi Rudolf,
Greetings of the day!
As the technician has troubleshot all the necessary connections to the HMI and the screen remains black, we recommend replacing the HMI with a Generation 2 model. We also assume that the Dlogic software was previously updated on the HMI. If not, we suggest performing the update. Additionally, if the DP cable has not been replaced with a new one, we recommend replacing it before replacing the HMI.
MLFB  : 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 (Controlpanel Adaptation Set)
Thank you.
